exclusions.name: Other council members or alternates
exclusions.why_safe: The council has exactly five members as per e1; no alternates or substitutes are mentioned. Any other person cannot vote.

exclusions.name: Remote participation
exclusions.why_safe: Council rules require physical presence and no remote provision exists (e4). Thus absence means no vote.

exclusions.name: Mayoral veto or other procedural hurdles
exclusions.why_safe: The question only asks about adoption at the session; the charter requires three affirmative votes (e3). No veto or other step is mentioned in evidence.

uncertainties.meaning: Whether Okonkwo will be physically present at the 8 September session and vote yes as she stated. No evidence confirms her attendance or that she will not change her vote.
Whether Tran will be physically present and vote yes as he stated. No evidence confirms his attendance or that he will not change his vote.
Whether Delgado will be physically present and vote no as she stated. No evidence confirms her attendance or that she will not change her vote.
Whether Pryce will be physically present and vote no as he stated. No evidence confirms his attendance or that he will not change his vote.
Whether the vote will actually be taken at the session. Under council rules, the sponsor (Okonkwo) could move postponement, which would prevent a vote.
